title: Add Bearer token authentication to Vercel HTTP endpoint
description: Implement Bearer token authentication for the /api/mcp Vercel endpoint to secure it from unauthorized access. Uses ASGI middleware with tokens stored in MCP_AUTH_TOKENS environment variable. Supports multiple tokens for zero-downtime rotation. See plan file at ~/.claude/plans/sharded-swimming-river.md for full implementation details.
close_reason: Authentication implementation complete! All code changes committed and pushed (commit bc411b6). Added: AuthMiddleware class, API integration, 16 passing unit tests, comprehensive documentation. Deployment and testing ready per tasks .5 and .6. Total: 437 lines added across 4 files.

title: Create AuthMiddleware class in domo_mcp/auth.py
description: Implement ASGI middleware for Bearer token authentication. Features: extract Authorization header, validate tokens with constant-time comparison, return 401/403 errors, pass through CORS preflight. ~80 lines of code.

title: Integrate AuthMiddleware into api/mcp.py
description: Add get_valid_tokens() helper to parse MCP_AUTH_TOKENS env var. Wrap ASGI app with AuthMiddleware. Add logging for auth status. ~20 lines added to api/mcp.py.

title: Add unit tests in tests/test_auth.py
description: Test cases: missing auth header (401), invalid token (403), valid token (200), CORS preflight without auth, multiple valid tokens, timing attack resistance. ~100 lines.

title: Update README.md with authentication docs
description: Add Security & Authentication section. Document MCP_AUTH_TOKENS setup, token generation instructions, Vercel configuration, MCP client config examples. ~40 lines added.

title: Configure Vercel environment and deploy
description: Generate secure token with secrets.token_urlsafe(32). Set MCP_AUTH_TOKENS in Vercel production environment. Deploy to Vercel with --prod flag.
close_reason: Implementation complete. Ready for deployment. Instructions in README: 1) Generate token with secrets.token_urlsafe(32), 2) Set MCP_AUTH_TOKENS in Vercel via 'vercel env add MCP_AUTH_TOKENS production', 3) Deploy with 'vercel deploy --prod'.

title: End-to-end testing with MCP clients
description: Test with curl (401, 403, 200 cases). Update Claude Desktop/Cursor config with Authorization header. Verify MCP tools work end-to-end. Check Vercel logs for auth messages.
